channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Four Checks for Setting Slippage on Your First Swap
item.description: Set slippage from the quoted price movement, pool depth, route and deadline; a tighter limit protects price but can make a volatile swap fail before signing.

item.title: Bridge arrival times depend on finality and liquidity
item.description: Bridge funding time depends on source-chain confirmation, the bridge’s release process and destination liquidity; check each stage before planning a trade.

item.title: A 2× price move leaves a 50/50 LP position 5.7% behind
item.description: A twofold relative price move leaves a 50/50 constant-product liquidity position about 5.7% behind holding the same tokens, before fees or gas at the new price.

item.title: Base LPs should time withdrawals around pool conditions
item.description: Base liquidity providers should weigh fee income against price exposure, pool depth and exit costs; a position’s range and withdrawal route change the trade-off.

item.title: Four factors that change TRON Energy use
item.description: TRON Energy depends on the contract path, inputs, storage changes and network demand, so estimate the exact call and separate execution cost from who pays it.

item.title: USDT loan repayment pending: what to check
item.description: A USDT repayment marked pending may be waiting on the blockchain or a lender-side update; check its transaction ID before paying again or contacting support.

item.title: TRON Energy rentals vary by term, minimum and payment fee
item.description: TRON Energy rentals have no network-wide standard term or minimum: match the quoted amount and expiry to the transfer, then compare the rental charge with TRX burned.

item.title: Five Checks Before Swapping XMR for USDT
item.description: Before swapping XMR for USDT, verify the destination network, delivered amount, liquidity, custody route and receiving address to avoid costly mismatches and delays.

item.title: Wrong-Chain Crypto Payouts: What to Check and Do
item.description: A wrong-chain crypto payout may still be recoverable: verify the transaction, identify who controls the address, then follow the correct wallet or exchange route.

item.title: Manta Bridge withdrawals take about three days
item.description: Manta Bridge withdrawals typically face a three-day Ethereum challenge period, followed by a proof and final claim; plan for extra time and Ethereum gas.

item.title: Arbswap: When to Swap and When to Farm
item.description: Use an Arbswap swap for a token trade; consider a farm only if you can supply a pair, accept price and reward risks, and meet any lock terms.

item.title: How to Tell a Token Transfer From a Swap
item.description: A token transfer records an asset moving between addresses; a swap exchanges assets through a contract, and the transaction receipt shows which occurred.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow finality upgrade on public testnet
item.description: Solana's Alpenglow consensus upgrade is active on testnet, where validators are testing a change targeting 150ms finality, down from about 12.8 seconds.
